name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your shoulders align with the pivot points of the machine. Sit with your chest against the pad.
Put the outside of your arms or elbows against the pads, or hold the handles, with your arms at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your shoulders. Do not shrug.
Pause for a moment, then lower the pads slowly to the start position, and repeat.
